reason: ASK-965: correct a FALSE ENFORCED claim I introduced. The rule's own body says these clauses are NOT gated; token-guard.py is wired and blocking but implements neither. That is precisely the residue the lint documents - it proves a wired blocking executable EXISTS, never that it implements THIS clause - so where a rule's own text contradicts the status, the status is wrong. Both retired references stay named in superseded_by, which the exec-ref ratchet requires and which also records exactly what was wrongly claimed.
